sentences.text: Keep bilges clean and free of oil and fuel, which also helps you spot new leaks.
Inspect fuel lines, hose clamps, tank vents and fuel tanks regularly for chafe, corrosion and seepage.
Store oily rags, paints and solvents in proper containers, since oily rags can heat up and ignite on their own.
Limit smoking to safe areas, if you allow it at all.
A few minutes of inspection before each trip is far easier than fighting a fire offshore with six passengers aboard.
